verdict.rationale: Working Copy supports secure credential storage via Identities (SSH keys stored in the Secure Enclave, protected by Face ID/Touch ID, and can be imported/generated) and supports connecting to many host types (GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, Gitea, BitBucket, etc.), implying credentials could be reused. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming one Identity/credential can be attached to and reused across multiple different repositories or hosts simultaneously, nor any independent verification of this workflow. Missing for 10: explicit multi-host credential reuse documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of cross-host credential sharing.
